targetText: The ideal of the bourgeoisie was the married couple, where the partners complemented each other so completely that they had no need of contact with society. The old ideal was "all for the loved one"; communist morality demands all for the collective.
explanation: Replacing bourgeois couple isolation with revolutionary class solidarity: communist morality prioritizes collective social commitment over individualistic domestic introversion.

targetText: (4) A jealous and proprietary attitude to the person loved must be replaced by a comradely understanding of the other and an acceptance of his or her freedom. Jealousy is a destructive force of which communist morality cannot approve.
explanation: Eradicating marital possessiveness: jealousy is identified as a survival of private property ideology, to be replaced by mutual respect, freedom, and comradely understanding.
